about: Attorney Matthew D. Dubin is the founder and owner of The Dubin Law Group, a respected Seattle personal injury law firm serving clients throughout Seattle, Everett, Tacoma, Redmond, Spokane, and communities across Washington State. Since beginning his legal career in 1995 and founding the firm in 1998, Matt has dedicated his practice exclusively to representing individuals and families whose lives have been changed by serious injuries and wrongful death caused by negligence.

With more than 30 years of legal experience, Matt has successfully represented clients in a broad range of personal injury cases, including car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, slip and fall accidents, medical negligence, dangerous and defective products, nursing home neglect, child injury claims, catastrophic injuries, and wrongful death. Throughout his career, he has recovered more than $100 million for injury victims, helping them secure the financial resources they need to rebuild their lives after devastating accidents.

Matt is widely recognized for combining strategic legal advocacy with compassionate client service. He works closely with every client to explain their legal rights, navigate complex insurance claims, and pursue maximum compensation for medical expenses, lost income, pain and suffering, and other damages. His commitment to protecting injured people from powerful insurance companies and corporations has earned him a reputation as one of Washington's trusted personal injury attorneys.

A graduate of Yale University (1990) and the University of Washington School of Law (1995), Matt has earned many of the legal profession's highest honors. He holds the prestigious AV Preeminent® Peer Review Rating from Martindale-Hubbell®, recognizing the highest levels of legal ability and ethical standards. He has also been recognized as a Top 100 Trial Lawyer by The National Trial Lawyers, a Top One Percent Lawyer by the National Association of Distinguished Counsel, a Top Personal Injury Attorney in the Nation by the National Academy of Personal Injury Attorneys, and has received Superb client ratings on Avvo.

Beyond representing injury victims, Matt is committed to educating the public about personal injury law, insurance claims, and accident prevention. He is the bestselling author of Maximizing Your Injury Claim: Simple Steps to Protect Your Family After an Accident and regularly speaks and writes on topics related to personal injury law, highway safety, and protecting the rights of accident victims. He is also an active member of the Washington State Bar Association, the King County Bar Association, the Washington State Association for Justice, the American Association for Justice, and the American Bar Association.

AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished, and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with Martindale-Hubbell's certification procedures, standards, and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and judiciary regarding legal ability and ethical standards.
